jobs.title: Contract Student Worker - Machine Learning Engineer
jobs.description:
**About Zoox**

Zoox is an autonomous ridehailing company building the world's first purpose-built robotaxi — fully electric, bidirectional, with no steering wheel or driver's seat. Backed by Amazon and founded to make transportation safer, cleaner, and more accessible, Zoox designs its vehicles entirely around the rider. We're currently operating in Las Vegas and San Francisco, with Austin and Miami on the horizon, and testing underway across seven U.S. markets.

**About Our Contract Student Worker Program**

Zoox's contract student worker program puts you at the center of one of the most ambitious challenges in transportation. You'll contribute to real projects, work alongside engineers and researchers pushing the boundaries of autonomous technology, and gain experience that goes well beyond the classroom. We're looking for students who bring strong academic foundations, curiosity that doesn't stop at coursework, and a drive to be part of something that matters.

### **Role Overview**

In this role, you will collaborate closely with the cross-functional engineering team to prepare and refine raw datasets, ensuring high data quality and pipeline integrity. You will assist in training and fine-tuning machine learning models using industry-standard frameworks and modern architectures. Additionally, you will validate model performance against rigorous benchmarks to ensure production readiness, reliability, and accuracy before deployment.

### **Responsibilities**

* Review data labeling quality
* Help other engineers on model training experiments
* Validate the model results with detailed triages

### **Required Qualifications**

* Python proficiency
* Machine learning
* Computer vision
* Robotics

### **Bonus Qualifications**

C++

### **Program Requirements**

* Currently enrolled in a B.S. or M.S. program in a relevant discipline.
* Available to commit to a minimum three-month assignment.
* Able to commit a minimum of 20 hours per week.
* Able to work on-site at one of our office locations.
* Must adhere with Zoox confidentiality requirements, including refraining from using or sharing proprietary company information outside of Zoox, such as in academic research, theses, publications, or presentations.

We want to be transparent: this is not an internship. The Contract Student Worker Program is designed to complement your academic experience by providing meaningful, ongoing work alongside your studies. Rather than participating in a cohort-based program, you'll join a team directly and contribute to real projects with real impact. While the program does not include structured intern programming or a pathway to full-time employment, it offers valuable opportunities to learn, develop new skills, and gain hands-on experience in a professional environment.

Compensation for this role is $30/hour.

This is a contract position; employment will be through a vendor contracted with Zoox. The hourly rate is as posted, and benefits eligibility is determined by the vendor.

**About Zoox**

Zoox is developing the first ground-up, fully autonomous vehicle fleet and the supporting ecosystem required to bring this technology to market. Sitting at the intersection of robotics, machine learning, and design, Zoox aims to provide the next generation of mobility-as-a-service in urban environments. We’re looking for top talent that shares our passion and wants to be part of a fast-moving and highly execution-oriented team.

Follow us on LinkedIn

**Accommodations**

If you need an accommodation to participate in the application or interview process please reach out to accommodations@zoox.com or your assigned recruiter.

***A Final Note:***

*You do not need to match every listed expectation to apply for this position. Here at Zoox, we know that diverse perspectives foster the innovation we need to be successful, and we are committed to building a team that encompasses a variety of backgrounds, experiences, and skills.*

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

jobs.title: Full-Stack Software Engineer, Reinforcement Learning
jobs.description:
### **About the Role**

Build product interfaces, backend systems, and internal tools for a reinforcement learning data platform. You will own experiences that help research teams and external partners create, evaluate, and improve training data, working closely with research, operations, and go-to-market teams.

### **What You'll Do**

* Develop tools for browsing environments, inspecting trajectories, reviewing task quality, and understanding model behavior.
* Build partner workflows for creating, submitting, testing, and iterating on reinforcement learning environments and training data.
* Create dashboards and observability tools for environment quality, evaluation results, data collection progress, and pipeline health.
* Design backend services and APIs that connect task authoring, data collection, evaluation, quality assurance, and training infrastructure.
* Work with cross-functional teams to turn ambiguous needs into polished products and ship improvements quickly.

### **What We're Looking For**

* At least 3 years of full-stack engineering experience building and shipping production systems, with technical field study or equivalent technical fundamentals.
* Proficiency in Python and a modern web stack such as React, TypeScript, or Next.js.
* Hands-on experience with AI, machine learning, or reinforcement learning, and experience owning products from design through deployment.
* Experience building backend services, APIs, and databases, as well as dashboards, monitoring tools, or observability interfaces.
* Comfort with cloud infrastructure, Docker, CI/CD, and production debugging.
* Experience with data inspection, review, quality assessment, data collection, labeling, or evaluation tools is valuable. AWS, Kubernetes, Terraform, and Grafana experience is also useful.
* Strong product judgment, independent execution, and communication across technical and non-technical teams.

### **Compensation & Benefits**

Base salary is $130,000 to $225,000 USD annually. Visa sponsorship and relocation support are available for qualified full-time candidates moving to the United States or Singapore.

### **Location**

On-site in San Francisco, California. Singapore-based and remote candidates with substantial overlap with San Francisco or Singapore time zones may also be considered.

Compensation Range: $130K - $225K

jobs.title: Research Engineer, Privacy and Anonymization
jobs.description:
### **About the Role**

Join a research and engineering team building privacy and anonymization systems for sensitive data used in AI training. You will help protect personal and confidential information while preserving the structure and utility of data for downstream workflows.

### **What You'll Do**

* Build systems to detect personally identifiable information, quasi-identifiers, credentials, and other sensitive content, then select transformations suited to the data and its intended use.
* Develop and benchmark detection methods that combine rules, statistical models, classifiers, and language models.
* Build production pipelines that anonymize raw data before it reaches processing, training, evaluation, or synthetic data workflows.
* Create evaluation frameworks for privacy risk and retained data utility, including recall-weighted metrics, leakage tests, and adversarial re-identification attempts.
* Design robust systems that handle new data sources, schema drift, unusual formats, and sensitive information in unexpected fields.
* Work with engineering, research, operations, and customers to turn privacy requirements into practical policies and safeguards.

### **What We're Looking For**

* At least 2 years of experience building production data or machine learning systems in Python, with strong Python proficiency.
* A technical education or equivalent technical background, and experience building end-to-end data processing pipelines.
* Hands-on experience detecting, removing, or anonymizing PII while preserving useful characteristics, using information extraction, named-entity recognition, classification, or related methods.
* Experience benchmarking detection methods and evaluating recall, precision, latency, cost, and downstream data utility.
* Understanding of redaction, masking, pseudonymization, anonymization, and synthetic data generation.
* Experience designing systems resilient to schema drift, unusual data formats, and processing edge cases.
* Experience with privacy-enhancing technologies such as differential privacy, k-anonymity, secure aggregation, or format-preserving encryption is valuable.
* Experience with high-throughput or low-latency inference, sensitive data in areas such as healthcare, finance, or security, or taking research systems into production is also valuable.

### **Compensation & Benefits**

Base salary: $130,000 to $225,000 USD annually. Visa sponsorship is available.

### **Location**

On-site in San Francisco, California, United States.

Compensation Range: $130K - $225K

As a member of this team, you will own and scale the pipeline behind these numbers, driving innovation in ML model scoring, sampling, and projections while making the system faster, more reliable, and easier to audit. You will work closely with a team of talented engineers and researchers in a fast paced, collaborative environment as Zoox expands to more cities and software releases.

### **In this role, you will:**

* Build and maintain the Behavior Evaluation data pipelines (PySpark/zspark medallion architecture on Databricks, EMR Serverless and Airflow) that produce weekly per-geofence estimates.
* Turn the statistical method (sampling, triage weights, mileage sharing, projections) into tested, reproducible code with checks that fail loudly when the data is bad.
* Build tools that cut the manual work in each weekly run.
* Work with cross functional stakeholders so the methodology is applied consistently in code and in clearance reports.
* Help adapt to new release methodologies and new geofences.

### **Qualifications:**

* 7 - 9 Years of experience or 5+ years with a strong data-platform track record
* Expert Python, with production experience in PySpark/Spark and Pandas
* Experience designing scalable batch data pipelines: orchestration, Delta/lakehouse tables, idempotent backfills
* Solid grounding in applied statistics: sampling, weighting, estimators, confidence intervals
* Strong testing and CI habits for data code

* Experience with autonomous-vehicle simulation, safety metrics or triage workflows
* Experience putting ML models into production in a data pipeline

**Join us and make YOUR mark on the World!**

Lawrence Livermore National Laboratory (LLNL) has turned bold ideas into world-changing impact advancing science and technology to strengthen U.S. security and promote global stability.

Our mission spans four critical national security areas nuclear deterrence, threat preparedness, energy security, and multi-domain defense empowering teams to take on the toughest challenges of today and tomorrow. With a culture built on innovation and operational excellence, LLNL is a place where your expertise can make a real impact.

The Extreme Light, Matter, and Fusion Directorate (LMF), formerly the NIF & Photon Science Directorate, is seeking a **Computational Automation and Data Science** Scientist to leverage AI to support the automation, optimization, and integration of manual computational procedures used in scientific research, engineering, and laboratory operations. The successful candidate will develop data-analysis algorithms, machine-learning applications, database interfaces, and automated workflows that improve efficiency, repeatability, and decision-making.

This position will work within an interdisciplinary research and development environment and collaborate with scientists, engineers, technicians, software developers, and industrial partners. jobs.description:
Summary
  
  
Apple is where we use the power of technology to enrich people's lives. Every new product we build, service we create, or Apple Store experience we deliver is the result of us making each other's ideas stronger. That happens because every one of us shares a belief that we can make something wonderful and share it with the world, changing lives for the better. It's the diversity of our people and their thinking that inspires the innovation that runs through everything we do. When we bring everybody in, we can do the best work of our lives. Here, you'll do more than join something — you'll add something. Join the Apple Ads Engineering team and help build an advertising platform that benefits both customers and advertisers. Our technology makes advertising possible on the App Store, Apple News, Stocks, and Apple TV — helping people discover content, supporting creators and publishers, and connecting advertisers of all sizes with engaged audiences, all with the unwavering commitment to privacy you expect from Apple. In this role, you will design, develop, and launch the highly-performant, internet-scale backend systems that select and deliver the right ads in real time, collaborating across engineering, product, and infrastructure to bring elegant solutions into production at Apple scale.
  
  
Description
  
  
You will design, develop, and operate the distributed services that make real-time ad selection possible at Apple. You will architect and build low-latency, high-availability, high-throughput ad-serving systems in a cloud environment, engineer secure and scalable data processing pipelines that operate on petabyte-scale datasets, and implement performant services that handle very high data volumes and QPS. You will work cross-functionally to ensure that optimal and correct ads are available for real-time selection, and that observability and flexibility are provided for stakeholders. While this role focuses on the candidate retrieval part of Apple Ads, we are not constrained by organization structure and offer the flexibility to contribute across a variety of backend systems, including opportunities to apply algorithmic search, machine learning, NLP, and AI to hard retrieval problems. You will write clean, efficient, well-documented code, participate in code reviews, and mentor other engineers on the team. Collaboration with internal partners across indexing, search, serving, operations, and program management to define requirements and deliver high-quality solutions is essential. You should be passionate about building products that protect user privacy and thrive in a fast-paced environment with rapidly changing priorities — and have fun doing it.
  
  
Minimum Qualifications  
  
  

* 3+ years of industry experience architecting and developing internet-scale server software for Linux systems, including scalable micro-services or data-driven platforms.
* Strong background in computer science fundamentals, including algorithms and data structures.
* Strong coding skills in Go, Java, Rust, C++, Scala, or a similar OOP/Functional language.
* Hands-on experience designing and operating scalable micro-services.
* Experience with search technologies such as Lucene, Solr, or Elasticsearch. Expertise with NoSQL datastores (e.g., Cassandra).
* Proficiency with data processing technologies (e.g., Kafka, Spark, Flink) and methods for processing petabyte-scale datasets.
* Experience with AWS services such as Amazon S3, EC2, and EKS/Kubernetes. Strong problem-solving and debugging skills.
* Demonstrated ability to work on complex problems and systems, alone or as part of a team, to deliver complete systems end to end.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to work effectively with technical and non-technical cross-functional teams, including operations and project management partners.
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or equivalent experience.

  
  
  
Preferred Qualifications  
  
  

* Experience creating groundbreaking technology for algorithmic search, machine learning, natural language processing, and artificial intelligence.
* Experience building ad-serving, recommendation, or large-scale retrieval systems.
* Familiarity with real-time bidding, candidate retrieval, or ranking pipelines.
* Experience operating services with strict latency and availability SLOs.
* Familiarity with privacy-preserving system design and data-handling practices.
* Strong understanding of distributed systems fundamentals — consensus, replication, and fault tolerance.
* A desire to work in a fast-paced and challenging environment, and a fast learner with strong motivation for growing and learning new technologies.

  
  
  
At Apple, base pay is one part of our total compensation package and is determined within a range. This provides the opportunity to progress as you grow and develop within a role. The base pay range for this role is between $150,400 and $277,600, and your base pay will depend on your skills, qualifications, experience, and location.  
  
Apple employees also have the opportunity to become an Apple shareholder through participation in Apple’s discretionary employee stock programs. Apple employees are eligible for discretionary restricted stock unit awards, and can purchase Apple stock at a discount if voluntarily participating in Apple’s Employee Stock Purchase Plan. You’ll also receive benefits including: Comprehensive medical and dental coverage, retirement benefits, a range of discounted products and free services, and for formal education related to advancing your career at Apple, reimbursement for certain educational expenses — including tuition. jobs.title: Research Engineer/Research Scientist in World Models and Simulation
jobs.description:
We are seeking a hands-on [Research Engineer/Research Scientist] with expertise in world modeling, video generation, predictive modeling, or learned simulation. You will develop models that generate environments and future observations, capture temporal dynamics, and respond to actions or interventions.

You will own research problems from hypothesis and implementation through training, evaluation, and failure analysis. Working with colleagues across modeling, data, evaluation, and infrastructure, you will translate research ideas into working models and measurable improvements.

**About the Team**
------------------

Our team has a background in autonomous driving, where understanding dynamic scenes, anticipating interactions, and evaluating the consequences of actions are central challenges. This experience shapes our research into how models can learn to represent, generate, and predict the physical world.

Building on this foundation, we develop learned world models for world generation, future prediction, and simulation. Our work combines video generation with representations of scene structure, motion, and interactions to model how environments evolve under different actions and conditions. We aim to create controllable, coherent simulations that support autonomous driving research and development.

Our research spans model architecture, training methods, data, and evaluation, with a focus on long-horizon consistency, multi-view coherence, and physically plausible dynamics. We bring together modeling and engineering to turn new ideas into working systems and measurable advances in both visual quality and predictive behavior.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

* Research, develop, and adapt models for world generation, future prediction, and simulation.
* Advance model capabilities in controllability, consistency, and realistic world dynamics.

jobs.description:
**Join the Future of Commerce with Whatnot!**
---------------------------------------------

Whatnot is the largest live shopping platform in North America and Europe to buy, sell, and discover the things you love. Whether it's trading cards, fashion, electronics, or live plants, our sellers are building real businesses across hundreds of categories. We're building live commerce at a scale that's never been done in the West, and there's no playbook to copy. The people here are shaping how an entirely new industry develops.

As a remote co-located team, we're inspired by our values and anchored in hubs across the US, UK, Ireland, Poland, Germany, and Australia. We move fast, stay close to our users, and focus on the work that drives the most impact.

We're one of the fastest growing marketplaces and were recently named the #1 Best Startup Employer in America by Forbes. Check out the latest Whatnot updates on our news and engineering blogs and join us as we enable anyone to turn their passion into a business and bring people together through commerce.

**Role**
--------

* Lead research projects across the marketplace dynamics problem area: simulation, auction and allocation mechanics, long-term objective modeling, exploration and information value, or marketplace experimentation methods
* Take ideas from hypothesis to production: literature review, prototyping, offline validation, shadow testing, and online experiments shipped through partner teams in Discovery and the Seller org
* Build models of how the marketplace behaves as a system: learned simulators that predict segment-level effects of ranking and policy changes, and surrogate models of long-term marketplace outcomes

We harness machine learning at Amazon's scale to make the customer experience easier and smoother. Our impact is large. For example, if your innovations save even 1 minute per customer per year, then for every 100 million customers, you save approximately 190 years of human effort.  
  
Key job responsibilities  
As an Applied Scientist on the Search L1 Ranking team, you will build search ranking models that work for thousands of product types, billions of queries, and hundreds of millions of customers spread around the world. You will find the next set of big improvements to ranking, leverage large datasets to understand the complexities of customer behavior, and build ML models that work at Amazon scale. Amazon's Search ranking relies on efficient early stage ranking followed by power final stage ranking models. this role focuses on efficient models for early stage ranking phase, and techniques to personalize these models and optimize them automatically.  
  
A day in the life  
Our primary focus is improving search ranking systems. On a day-to-day this means building ML models, analyzing data from your recent A/B tests, and collaborating with partner teams on joint goals. We leverage agentic workflows to improve our scientific velocity, and partner closely with SDEs to bring our ideas to production. You will shape the future of search ranking by presenting proposals to Amazon's business and tech leaders.  
  
About the team  
We are a team consisting of ML scientists and software engineers. Our interests span machine learned ranking models, distilled LLMs for efficient inference, personalization techniques to refine the ranking of our models, reinforcement learning to bring the benefits of exploration to search ranking, and infrastructure to make it all happen at scale and efficiently.

jobs.title: Machine Learning Scientist, Frontier Research, AI for Drug Discovery (AIDD)
jobs.description:
### **The Position**

A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love. That’s what makes us Roche.  
  
Advances in AI, data, and computational sciences are transforming drug discovery and development. Roche’s Research and Early Development organisations at Genentech (gRED) and Pharma (pRED) have demonstrated how these technologies accelerate R&D, leveraging data and novel computational models to drive impact. Seamless data sharing and access to models across gRED and pRED are essential to maximising these opportunities. The new Computational Sciences Center of Excellence (CoE) is a strategic, unified group whose goal is to harness the transformative power of data and Artificial Intelligence (AI) to assist our scientists in both pRED and gRED to deliver more innovative and transformative medicines for patients worldwide.

  

**The Opportunity**

Within AI for Drug Discovery, the Frontier Research team advances fundamental machine learning and statistics methods, motivated by real-world challenges in drug discovery. In biology and medicine, many important problems cannot yet be addressed with off-the-shelf machine learning approaches—they demand not only novel solutions, but also new paradigms for framing and thinking about the problems themselves. Instead of focusing on incremental improvements, we work on long-horizon ideas that require a creative and broad perspective, developing solutions at a level that can be instantiated for multiple internal and external applications. If you’re excited about this kind of research, join us on an impactful journey of innovation at Prescient.

jobs.title: Senior Data Scientist, Marketplace Economics
jobs.description:
Every day, tens of millions of people come to Roblox to explore, create, play, learn, and connect with friends in 3D immersive digital experiences– all created by our global community of developers and creators.

At Roblox, we're building the tools and platform that empower our community to bring any experience that they can imagine to life. Our vision is to reimagine the way people come together, from anywhere in the world, and on any device.We're on a mission to connect a billion people with optimism and civility, and looking for amazing talent to help us get there.

A career at Roblox means you'll be working to shape the future of human interaction, solving unique technical challenges at scale, and helping to create safer, more civil shared experiences for everyone.

At Roblox, we're building the tools and platform that empower a global community of creators and developers to build immersive experiences and a dynamic virtual economy. Our Data Science organization sits at the heart of this mission, delivering the strategic and causal insights that power pricing, market health, and creator success across all Economy surfaces.

We are looking for a Senior Data Scientist to lead the methodological and strategic foundations for our Creator Economics systems. Roblox operates multiple two-sided marketplaces, from the Avatar Marketplace to in-experience economies. You will build the economic systems and measurement frameworks that inform how value flows through the platform, such as building price optimization systems, designing new rev-share models, and establishing the economics for new UGC category launches. You will serve as a technical leader driving the roadmap for our most critical developer and creator touchpoints.

Why Marketplace Economics?

* **Real-world scale:** Power millions of daily economic interactions across a complex, two-sided marketplace where millions of creators meet over 100 million daily active users.
* **Complex markets, rich signals:** Design economic systems and measurement frameworks that account for the nuances of a two-sided marketplace, social network effects, long-term user attachment, and supply response.
* **Strategic ownership:** Lead projects from scratch, translating ambiguous business and policy questions into rigorous quantitative frameworks that directly influence high-stakes company decisions on the economics of our Marketplace.
* **Impact meets innovation:** Partner with Product and Engineering to shape the future of the Roblox economy, building measurement solutions that optimize for long-term ecosystem health and growth.

You will:

* **Design Economic Systems**: Drive the structural design of creator and curator incentives, including formulating revenue-share models that foster a thriving, balanced ecosystem.
* **Master Pricing & Supply Response**: Architect models that evaluate price elasticity, marketplace clearing rates, and predict how creators (supply) respond to pricing shifts and new economic policies.
* **Spearhead UGC Category Launches**: Lead the quantitative strategy for introducing new User-Generated Content (UGC) categories, establishing the foundational economics and incentive structures needed to spark market liquidity.
* **Apply Deep Causal Inference**: Build rigorous observational and experimental causal inference solutions to isolate the true impact of market interventions on creator success and platform economics.
* **Drive Strategy**: Partner with product and engineering leaders as a primary scientific advocate, providing unbiased measurement and insights to accelerate innovation and strategic prioritization.

You have (at least some of) the following:

* **6+ years** of industry or research experience in Data Science or Economics, specifically within large-scale UGC content platforms, pricing, marketplace mechanism design, or creator economies.
* **Deep Methodological Expertise** in quantitative methodologies, causal inference (observational and experimental), and modern data stack tools (Python, R, SQL), alongside a deep theoretical understanding of econometrics and mechanism design.
* **Marketplace Intuition** with a proven track record of working with large-scale transactional or platform data to analyze micro-level user behavior and isolate its impact on long-term outcomes and platform health.
* **Executive Communication & Leadership** skills to distill high-dimensional economic problems into succinct, actionable narratives for non-technical executive audiences.
* **An Advanced Degree** (Master's or PhD) in Economics, Econometrics, Quantitative Finance, Statistics, Operations Research, Physics, Computer Science, or a related quantitative field.

Roles that are based in an office are onsite Tuesday, Wednesday, and Thursday, with optional presence on Monday and Friday (unless otherwise noted).

Roblox provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws. Roblox also provides reasonable accommodations to candidates with qualifying disabilities or religious beliefs during the recruiting process.

jobs.description:
**About the Role**

We are building a fleet of specialized AI services that improve high-value human workflows across the company. As a **Senior Software Engineer, Core AI,** you will design, build, evaluate, and operate production-grade AI services and agents. You will own work end to end—from data and context design through tool use, application logic, evaluation, and production monitoring.

**What You'll Do:**

* **Build specialized AI services:** design and implement task-specific services and agents, including data serialization, retrieval, memory where appropriate, tool integrations, and bounded multi-step reasoning.
* **Define and evaluate quality:** work with partners to make expected behavior explicit, write and maintain evals against representative examples, and use results to measure performance against expectations.
* **Improve quality systematically:** use evaluation findings, failure analysis, and production feedback to improve context and data, service logic, tools, and model behavior.
* **Build for production:** integrate tracing, observability, versioning, monitoring, reliability practices, and success metrics into the services you own.
* **Run controlled experiments:** compare models, data, and implementation approaches using repeatable benchmarks so improvements are attributable and reproducible.
* **Partner on architecture:** work with AI Architecture, AI Ops, and Platform teams to make services secure, reliable, cost-aware, and deployable at scale.
* **Ship iteratively:** move quickly from user problem to prototype to production, learning from real workflow outcomes.
  

**What We're Looking For:**

* 5+ years of strong software engineering experience delivering production services or products, ideally at senior or staff level.
* Hands-on experience building AI/LLM-powered applications or agents with real users or operational use.
* Experience with evaluation methods for AI behavior: defining expected outcomes, building test sets or evals, tracking regressions, and acting on results.
* A data-first mindset: able to shape retrieval, context, and serialization to give a model the information needed for the task.
* Good judgment about tool use, autonomy, human review, failure handling, privacy, reliability, latency, and cost.
* A product-minded approach focused on solving specific workflow problems and measuring whether the solution works.
* Comfort learning tools and frameworks; experience with agent runtimes, model APIs, MCP, tracing, or evaluation tools is helpful.

The future of healthcare is being built right now. Come deliver this transformation.

**About the Role**
------------------

We're hiring a Senior Software Engineer to own Commure's data warehouse platform end-to-end. You'll design, build, and operate every layer of the stack:

* CDC pipelines
* Streaming transport
* Schema governance and data contracts
* Query and serving layer
* Analytics platform

The core stack today: Debezium for CDC, StarRocks as our MPP query and serving engine, and dbt for transformation and modeling. This is a hands-on IC role with broad scope. You'll make architectural calls, write the code that matters most, and establish the patterns and conventions on the data platform.

**What You'll Do**
------------------

* Own the data warehouse platform end-to-end: CDC pipelines, data lake, query layer, transformation layer, and the analytics-facing tooling that sits on top.
* Design and operate CDC pipelines with Debezium (and Kafka, Redpanda, or an equivalent streaming backbone) that move data from operational databases into the warehouse with low latency and high fidelity.
* Architect the data lake on object storage using an open table format (Iceberg, Delta Lake, or Hudi) with Parquet, enabling both batch and streaming workloads and clean separation of storage from compute.
* Run and scale StarRocks (or adjacent MPP/lakehouse engines) as the query and serving layer - schema design, materialized views, ingestion patterns, tuning, and cost/performance trade-offs.
* Build the transformation layer with dbt: modeling standards, tests, documentation, and a semantic layer that gives every team a single source of truth for metrics.
* Stand up orchestration (Airflow, Dagster, or similar) and the CI/CD, observability, and data-quality tooling that make the platform trustworthy day-to-day.
* Partner with Security and Compliance on PHI/PII handling, access controls, lineage, and auditability so the platform meets HIPAA and SOC 2 bar by default.
* Collaborate with product and analytics teams on schema contracts, ingestion patterns, and self-serve tooling so they can build on the platform with confidence.

**What You Have**
-----------------

* 5+ years of software engineering experience, with significant time building or operating data platforms at scale.
* Experience across the modern data stack: CDC (Debezium or equivalent), streaming (Kafka, Redpanda), data lake formats (Iceberg, Delta, Hudi), an MPP or lakehouse query engine (StarRocks, ClickHouse, Trino, Snowflake, Databricks), and dbt.
* Fluent in SQL, schema design, query optimization, and reasoning about cost and latency trade-offs on large datasets.
* Experience running production data infrastructure (orchestration, observability, on-call, data quality, and incident response).

### **Preferred**

* Direct experience with Debezium, StarRocks, and dbt in production.
* Experience building semantic layers (dbt Semantic Layer, Cube) or data catalogs / lineage (DataHub, OpenMetadata, Amundsen).
* Experience with HIPAA-regulated data (PHI handling, de-identification, and access governance).
* Experience powering AI/ML workloads: feature stores, training-set curation, embedding pipelines, or retrieval systems.
* Experience across multiple clouds (AWS, GCP, Azure), infrastructure-as-code (Terraform, Pulumi) and Kubernetes controllers.

**Job Description**

General Motors is a global leader in advanced driver assistance. With Super Cruise hands-free technology in more than 500,000 Super Cruise–equipped vehicles on the road and over 700 million hands-free miles driven, GM is proving that automation can be trusted, intuitive, and helpful. GM has the global reach to bring cutting-edge advances to everyday drivers at unprecedented scale. Join us to help deliver the next generation of safe and delightful personal autonomous vehicle experiences.

  

**About the Team**

Every autonomous-driving engineer at GM eventually asks the same questions: *What happened on that drive? Where else has this happened? Why did the vehicle do that? Did my change fix it?* The AV Analysis team builds the tools that answer them, across the full life of AV data:

* Record and catalog new data as it comes in from the fleet, so engineers know what exists, where it came from, and whether it's ready to use.
* Index and mine road data alongside simulation output, so engineers can find the scenes that matter using structured filters, similarity search, and natural-language queries.
Analyze what happened by replaying sensor data, perception output, and planner decisions in synchronized 3D, camera, plot, and map views. Engineers do this to triage and diagnose an issue, or to validate a new change.  

  

Perception, planning, simulation, mapping, validation, and data teams use these tools every day. That work spans next-generation autonomous development vehicles, Super Cruise programs, and autonomous mobile robots in GM factories. We're part of AV Tooling, which also builds GM's fleet-operations tools and AI-assisted triage. Our senior engineers don't wait for a spec. Demand for our tools outpaces any roadmap, so the most valuable thing you'll do is decide what to build. * Keep tools fast and reliable in production, and raise the bar for the team's engineering systems: tests, CI speed, developer experience, observability, and on-call.
Mentor engineers, and use AI-assisted development and agentic workflows to multiply what a small team can deliver.

**What Will Give You a Competitive Edge (Preferred Qualifications)**

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, Autonomy Evaluation & Metrics Platform
jobs.description:
Rivian’s Autonomy Eval Infrastructure team builds the software that helps engineers understand  
and improve the ML models behind our driving systems and gives release teams evidence they  
can trust. Within Autonomy’s AI Platform organization, we connect model development with  
evaluation workflows, metrics, triage and visualization across simulation and real-world vehicle  
data.

As a senior metrics-platform engineer, you will design, build and operate a substantial part of  
the platform that makes autonomy evaluation consistent and reproducible. Working directly with  
Perception, Planning and Systems engineers, you will connect model experiments to reliable  
metrics and help turn insights about model behavior, failure modes and generalization into  
improvements in models and data.  
This is a hands-on software engineering role. You will own projects through design,  
implementation, rollout and operation, make practical system-design trade-offs, and mentor  
teammates. As an early member of a newly formed team, you will help establish the engineering  
practices and interfaces that make the platform useful across Autonomy.

  

* Own the design and delivery of a metrics-platform area, such as the metric registry,  
  computation services or comparison and reporting APIs, in partnership with the team’s  
  technical lead.
* Design versioned metric definitions and data models for inputs, aggregation, slicing and  
  results. Preserve provenance linking official evaluation runs to code, model, dataset and  
  scenario versions.
* Build distributed computation and storage paths with idempotent execution, incremental  
  processing and controlled backfills. Make informed trade-offs across throughput, latency,  
  cost and reproducibility.
* Build comparison tools that expose coverage, sample sizes, uncertainty and changes in  
  evaluation inputs. Help users distinguish model regressions from data, simulator or  
  infrastructure failures.
* Partner with model developers to design evaluation experiments, inspect predictions and  
  analyze failure patterns. Use the findings to guide model and data improvements, and  
  build reusable evaluation harnesses that shorten the iteration cycle.
* Integrate metrics and regression checks into replay and closed-loop evaluation  
  workflows and CI. Partner with domain owners on metric semantics and thresholds, and  
  with Systems on evidence for release decisions.
* Deliver self-service APIs and scorecards backed by consistent definitions and results.  
  Migrate existing consumers incrementally while preserving reporting continuity and  
  traceability.
* Own reliability and performance for your services through testing, observability, incident  
  investigation and operational documentation; measure improvements in turnaround time,  
  correctness and cost.
* Write and review production code, lead design reviews for your projects, mentor  
  engineers, and collaborate across Palo Alto, London and Belgrade to deliver software  
  that users adopt.

  

* 5+ years of professional software engineering experience, or equivalent demonstrated  
  experience and impact, including ownership of production backend or data-intensive  
  systems.
* Hands-on experience building software for autonomy or robotics, with direct exposure to  
  evaluation, simulation, perception, planning or validation workflows.
* Strong Python programming skills, with the ability to write, test, profile and debug  
  maintainable production software.
* Practical SQL skills, with AI coding tools expected to support writing and refining  
  queries; ability to validate query logic, results and performance.
* Demonstrated system-design ability across service APIs, data modeling, distributed  
  processing and storage, including failure recovery, consistency and performance  
  trade-offs.
* Experience taking a project from requirements and design through implementation,  
  rollout and operation, coordinating dependencies and communicating trade-offs clearly.
* Practical understanding of model inference and evaluation, including held-out datasets,  
  generalization, reproducibility and model versioning, and the differences between  
  open-loop replay, closed-loop simulation and real-world measurements.
* Ability to reason about sampling, confidence intervals, noisy metrics and valid  
  comparisons, and to work with domain experts when stronger statistical analysis is  
  needed.
* Experience with cloud infrastructure, containers, CI/CD and production observability,  
  plus a track record of constructive code review and mentoring.  
  Bonus Points
* Experience building metric registries, evaluation services, experiment-tracking systems  
  or automated regression gates used by multiple engineering teams.
* Experience with Spark, Databricks, Delta Lake or comparable distributed data systems,  
  and with AWS, Docker or GitLab CI.
* Experience migrating analytical or reporting systems without breaking downstream  
  consumers, or linking metrics to scenario-level debugging and triage.
* Experience with PyTorch or similar ML frameworks, evaluation of end-to-end driving  
  models, or connecting offline model metrics to closed-loop and real-world driving  
  behavior.

It all started when engineer Fred Luddy wrote code that automated a tedious task for his coworker, Phyllis. She cried tears of joy. That moment inspired Fred to build a company that could do that for everyone—freeing people from busywork so they could focus on meaningful work. Today, ServiceNow is the AI control tower for business reinvention. Our ServiceNow AI platform brings together any AI, any data, and any workflow— helping 85% of the Fortune 500® work smarter, faster, and better. We're building an AI-native culture where technology and talent are unstoppable together. And we're just getting started.

Join us to put AI to work for people.

 **Job Description**

Contribute to the org-wide shift from product-specific search solutions to a composable, agent-native infrastructure foundation that agents and applications build on to locate, search, discover, and recommend resources across heterogeneous enterprise data.

* Build and own the infrastructural substrate beneath the agentic search platform, spanning the index engine, the ingestion and enrichment pipeline, and the entity, identity, and feature intelligence that gives content context. Solve the hard problem of keeping index-time enrichments aligned with what agents expect at query time, so retrieval, ranking, and reasoning all build on a consistent foundation.
* Build and operate hybrid indexing technology at scale across large clusters, spanning keyword-based sparse-vector indices, embedding-based semantic indices, and emerging semantic-ID indexing driven by next-token prediction. Own the full index lifecycle, and expose clean, unified contracts to the search primitives and recipes that agents compose on top of the corpus.
* Design and run high-throughput ingestion and enrichment pipelines that produce a multi-representation, permission-aware corpus at index time. Orchestrate the stages that make content agent-ready, including parsing, chunking, embedding, entity resolution, and access control, and evolve them as new agentic use cases emerge.
* Build and operate multi-modal indexing across the full mix of enterprise data, from free text and structured content such as tables to diagrams, images, and audio and video. Represent each modality so it is retrievable through a unified surface, letting agents find the right material regardless of its form or source.
* Contribute to a knowledge graph that resolves entities across enterprise data sources, letting agents link disparate resources such as tickets, files, and people through canonical entity relationships.
* Improve the performance, scalability, and observability of search, including query latency, indexing throughput, and cluster health, to deliver low-latency, high-quality agentic search experiences. Apply techniques such as vector quantization to balance model quality, retrieval performance, and storage cost.
* Own search infrastructure end to end, from intake and design through rollout and ongoing operations, and help shape the search roadmap as the platform grows to support new agents, primitives, and recipes, including needs not yet anticipated.
* Drive reliability and operability across the platform through index lifecycle policies, capacity planning, and cluster scaling strategies that keep a growing library of reusable search capabilities healthy in production.

This is a highly collaborative, in-person role, working cross-functionally with Search Ranking, ML, and Platform engineering teams to deliver robust, production-grade agentic search capabilities.

* BS or MS in Computer Science or an equivalent engineering background; PhD is a plus.

* Excited to be part of an in-person team culture, collaborating on-site with colleagues every day.

jobs.title: Embedded Software Engineer, Haptics
jobs.description:
**About Hark**

Hark is an artificial intelligence company building advanced, personalized intelligence. One that is proactive, multimodal, and capable of interacting with the world through speech, text, vision, and persistent memory.

We're pairing that intelligence with next-generation hardware to create a universal interface between humans and machines. While today's AI largely operates through chat boxes and decade-old devices, Hark is focused on what comes next: agentic systems that interact naturally with people and the real world.

To get there, we're developing multimodal models and next-generation AI hardware together - designed from the ground up as a single, unified interface for a new era of intelligent systems.

**About the Role**

Hark is looking for an experience-focused, hands-on embedded engineer to build haptic and motion control system firmware and software that deliver incredible interaction experiences. We care a lot about how things feel, and how the people that use them feel, and we want someone who shares that craft mindset.

**Responsibilities**

* Write real-time firmware in C and C++ that drives motion and haptic systems.
* Close the loop on response time and feel. characterize actuator behavior on the bench and tune controllers until the result is genuinely pleasant to use.
* Stand up early hardware, prove out feel and timing in prototype form, and shape the final shipping experience alongside product and industrial design partners.

**Requirements**

* 5+ years writing firmware for microcontrollers in C and C++.
* Demonstrated hands-on motor or actuator control work that shipped — PID, feed-forward, FOC, observers, and similar techniques.
* Comfort on the bench with scopes, logic analyzers, and bus traffic over I²C, SPI, or I²S.
* Working knowledge of Python or another scripting language for measurement automation and quick data analysis.
* Clear written communication — you can explain a tradeoff to a non-firmware teammate without losing them.
* A strong instinct for what distinguishes haptics that feel right.

**Bonus Qualifications**

* DSP fundamentals: filtering, time-domain shaping, and basic perceptual modeling.
* RTOS experience or comfort with bare-metal scheduling for hard real-time control loops.
* Familiarity with low-power system design and the measurement habits that come with it.
* Prior work on consumer haptics, audio, or other systems where feel and timing are visible to the user.

At Blue Origin, we envision millions of people living and working in space for the benefit of Earth. We’re working to develop reusable, safe, and low-cost space vehicles and systems within a culture of safety, collaboration, and inclusion. Join our team of problem solvers as we add new chapters to the history of spaceflight!

Blue Origin is pioneering the future of space-based connectivity with TeraWave, a revolutionary satellite communications network designed to deliver symmetrical data speeds of up to 6 Tbps anywhere on Earth. This network will service tens of thousands of enterprise, data center, and government users who require reliable connectivity for critical operations.

We are looking for a **Senior Software Engineer** to architect and build the **PoP Control-Plane Network Services** —the software layer that manages, routes, and controls a dynamic mesh network of satellite customer terminals in real-time.

**The Role**

You will be a founding member of our next-generation PoP infrastructure team working on the **Control Plane** that orchestrates end to end connectivity across the entire network. Your work will ensure that customers maintain a highly available satellite connection between all their different end points as you build the "distributed brain" of a space-based ISP.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Architect the Control Plane:** Design and implement highly available, low-latency control plane services using microservices patterns to handle subscriber provisioning and session management.

* **Distributed Systems at Scale:** Build and maintain stateful distributed services that operate across terrestrial data centers and orbital nodes.

* **High-Throughput Database Design:** Develop and optimize database schemas (SQL, NoSQL, and Time-Series) to track billions of telemetry points.

**Required Qualifications**

* **Experience:** 8+ years

* **Languages:** Expert-level proficiency in **C++** , **Rust** , or **Go** .

* **Distributed Systems:** Deep experience with consensus algorithms ( **Raft, Paxos** ), distributed caching, and message brokers (Kafka, gRPC).

**Preferred Skills (Microservices & Distributed Systems Focus)**

* **Cloud-Native Architecture:** Extensive experience designing and deploying **microservices architectures** within containerized environments using **Kubernetes** (EKS/AKS or bare-metal).

* **Service Mesh & Discovery:** Proven track record with service mesh technologies (e.g., **Istio, Linkerd** ) and service discovery mechanisms in highly dynamic, multi-region environments.

* **Resiliency Patterns:** Expert knowledge of distributed system patterns including **circuit breakers, retries with exponential backoff, and bulkhead isolation** to ensure "five-nines" availability.

* **Event-Driven Design:** Experience building reactive, asynchronous systems using event-sourcing or CQRS patterns to manage high-velocity network state changes.

jobs.description:

Our platform spans the full care journey: Ambient AI and Dictation eliminating documentation burden at the point of care, intelligent Agents automating patient and revenue workflows, and autonomous RCM processing billions in claims, all on a single AI-native platform integrated with 60+ EHRs.

Healthcare carries a $1 trillion administrative burden and we're at the center of transforming it. Today, 500,000+ clinicians across 500+ healthcare organizations nationwide trust Commure to handle $25B+ in annual claims and support over 200 million patient interactions. Our latest $70M raise at a $7B valuation reflects the confidence the market has placed in this mission. We've also been named to the Fortune Future 50 list and the 2026 AI Breakthrough Awards for “Overall NLP Company of the Year.”

jobs.description:
**Company Description**

It all started in sunny San Diego, California in 2004 when a visionary engineer, Fred Luddy, saw the potential to transform how we work. Fast forward to today — ServiceNow stands as a global market leader, bringing innovative AI-enhanced technology to over 8,100 customers, including 85% of the Fortune 500®. Our intelligent cloud-based platform seamlessly connects people, systems, and processes to empower organizations to find smarter, faster, and better ways to work. But this is just the beginning of our journey. Join us as we pursue our purpose to make the world work better for everyone.

 **Job Description**

Contribute to the org-wide shift from product-specific search solutions to a composable, agent-native infrastructure foundation that agents and applications build on to locate, search, discover, and recommend resources across heterogeneous enterprise data.

  

* Build and own the infrastructural substrate beneath the agentic search platform, spanning the index engine, the ingestion and enrichment pipeline, and the entity, identity, and feature intelligence that gives content context. Solve the hard problem of keeping index-time enrichments aligned with what agents expect at query time, so retrieval, ranking, and reasoning all build on a consistent foundation.
* Build and operate hybrid indexing technology at scale across large clusters, spanning keyword-based sparse-vector indices, embedding-based semantic indices, and emerging semantic-ID indexing driven by next-token prediction. Own the full index lifecycle, and expose clean, unified contracts to the search primitives and recipes that agents compose on top of the corpus.
* Design and run high-throughput ingestion and enrichment pipelines that produce a multi-representation, permission-aware corpus at index time. Orchestrate the stages that make content agent-ready, including parsing, chunking, embedding, entity resolution, and access control, and evolve them as new agentic use cases emerge.
* Build and operate multi-modal indexing across the full mix of enterprise data, from free text and structured content such as tables to diagrams, images, and audio and video. Represent each modality so it is retrievable through a unified surface, letting agents find the right material regardless of its form or source.
* Contribute to a knowledge graph that resolves entities across enterprise data sources, letting agents link disparate resources such as tickets, files, and people through canonical entity relationships.
* Improve the performance, scalability, and observability of search, including query latency, indexing throughput, and cluster health, to deliver low-latency, high-quality agentic search experiences. Apply techniques such as vector quantization to balance model quality, retrieval performance, and storage cost.
* Own search infrastructure end to end, from intake and design through rollout and ongoing operations, and help shape the search roadmap as the platform grows to support new agents, primitives, and recipes, including needs not yet anticipated.
* Drive reliability and operability across the platform through index lifecycle policies, capacity planning, and cluster scaling strategies that keep a growing library of reusable search capabilities healthy in production.

This is a highly collaborative, in-person role, working cross-functionally with Search Ranking, ML, and Platform engineering teams to deliver robust, production-grade agentic search capabilities.

 **Qualifications**  

* BS or MS in Computer Science or an equivalent engineering background; PhD is a plus.

* Excited to be part of an in-person team culture, collaborating on-site with colleagues every day.

jobs.description:
### **About the Role**

Join a small engineering team developing autonomous systems in the defense technology sector. As a senior individual contributor, you will own the precision motion controls stack, from control-loop architecture and state estimation to integration and validation on real hardware.

### **What You'll Do**

* Design and tune precision pointing and tracking control loops, including closed-loop operation from sensor input to actuator commands at hundreds of hertz.
* Develop state estimation and sensor fusion using IMU, encoder, and vision feedback.
* Identify and model gimbal, mount, and actuator dynamics, and compensate for resonance, backlash, friction, saturation, and other nonlinearities.
* Build and maintain controls simulation and hardware-in-the-loop test infrastructure to validate designs and reduce the sim-to-real gap.
* Integrate controls with tracking systems and characterize performance on physical hardware in laboratory and field settings.
* Document controls architecture, tuning approaches, and engineering standards.

### **What We're Looking For**

* At least 4 years of robotics experience, including hands-on design and tuning of closed-loop controllers on motion hardware such as servo drives, brushless motors, encoders, and IMUs.
* Strong grounding in classical and state-space control, including LQR and MPC, with experience applying control methods to physical systems.
* Practical state-estimation experience, such as Kalman, EKF, UKF, or complementary filters, and sensor fusion on hardware.
* Experience with system identification, frequency-domain tuning, resonance characterization, and real-time control-loop latency and jitter.
* Modern C++ for real-time control, plus Python or MATLAB/Simulink for modeling, simulation, and analysis.
* Experience validating simulations against real hardware and working across mechanical, electrical, and software disciplines.
* Background in precision motion, gimbals, target tracking, aerospace, or other related control systems is valuable.

### **Compensation & Benefits**

Base salary: $180,000 to $200,000 annually. Visa sponsorship is not available.

### **Location**

On-site in San Francisco, California.

Compensation Range: $180K - $200K

jobs.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

Sponsored Products and Brands (SPB) helps millions of advertisers reach shoppers across Amazon's stores worldwide. Behind every ad we show are machine learning models that predict click-through rate (CTR) and conversion rate (CVR). These predictions decide which ads are relevant, how they rank, and how advertisers get value.  
  
Our team builds and runs the ML infrastructure behind those models, end to end:  
  

* Offline feature engineering: a multi-tenant platform used by several ML teams. It runs thousands of daily feature jobs over petabyte-scale data and produces the features that train models in every marketplace we serve.
* Model training: the standard system that retrains CTR and CVR models every day. How fresh these models are directly affects advertiser results and Amazon's revenue.
* Online feature store and feature retrieval: low-latency, high-throughput services that provide features when a model makes a prediction. These predictions feed the scores used in real-time ad ranking.
* Next-generation research platform: a platform that uses AI agents to help scientists explore, test and launch new model ideas faster.

  
As an SDE II, you'll design, build and run distributed systems that work at very large scale, both in offline batch processing and online serving. You'll work closely with applied scientists and engineers to make models fresher, help scientists try ideas faster, and keep the systems that support ads ranking reliable.  
  
Key job responsibilities  

* Design and develop ML infrastructure for advanced recommendation models, from training through real-time inference, that delivers highly relevant ads to shoppers worldwide
* Improve the scalability, automation and efficiency of large-scale training and real-time inference systems
* Work closely with applied scientists to optimize the performance of ML models and infrastructure, and take models from experimentation into production
* Deliver ML solutions end to end: design, implementation, testing, deployment and operations
* Collaborate with engineers and scientists across the team to build systems that serve ads across all Amazon platforms and surfaces
* Participate in design and code reviews and mentor peers

  
A day in the life  
You might start the day checking the health of the overnight feature and training pipelines. Then you'd work with scientists on how to support a new model architecture, and spend the afternoon building a performance improvement for the online feature store. You'll ship often, see your work affect ads served around the world, and influence how ML infrastructure grows across the organization.  
  
About the team  
The Sponsored Products and Brands team at Amazon Ads is re-imagining the advertising landscape through industry leading generative AI technologies, revolutionizing how millions of customers discover products and engage with brands across Amazon.com and beyond. We are at the forefront of re-inventing advertising experiences, bridging human creativity with artificial intelligence to transform every aspect of the advertising lifecycle from ad creation and optimization to performance analysis and customer insights. We are a passionate group of innovators dedicated to developing responsible and intelligent AI technologies that balance the needs of advertisers, enhance the shopping experience, and strengthen the marketplace. If you're energized by solving complex challenges and pushing the boundaries of what's possible with AI, join us in shaping the future of advertising.
  
  
We're the team behind the full ML lifecycle for Sponsored Products recommendation models, from raw data to features, training and real-time serving. We value ownership, getting things done, and close collaboration with science partners. We invest in mentorship and in tools that make engineers and scientists more productive, including AI-assisted development.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* 3+ years of software development engineer or related occupational experience
* 3+ years of designing and developing large-scale, multi-tiered, multi-threaded, embedded or distributed software applications, tools, systems, and services using: C#, C++, Java, or Perl experience
* 1+ years of building large-scale machine-learning infrastructure for online recommendation, ads ranking, personalization or search experience
* 1+ years of machine learning, statistical modeling, data mining, and analytics techniques experience
* Experience programming with at least one software programming language

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* 1+ years of mathematics optimization such as linear programming and nonlinear optimization experience
* Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related field

jobs.description:
Experienced

Technology

New York

**Machine Learning Engineers** at IMC play a pivotal role in building the systems that drive training and deployment of large-scale ML models across IMC's global operations. They collaborate with quantitative researchers, hardware specialists and software engineers to build robust systems that get the most out of GPU acceleration, distributed computing and the broader open-source ML ecosystem. ML Engineers' work directly shapes how fast we can experiment, iterate and deploy — accelerating the cycle that turns a research idea into a live trading strategy.

This is a unique opportunity to solve problems at the intersection of advanced machine learning and trading, where your contributions will shape the future of IMC's technology and trading capabilities.

As a team, our Machine Learning Engineers broadly work across two areas: **ML Research Engineering**, focused on the systems and frameworks researchers use to train, evaluate and iterate on models at scale; and **ML Performance Engineering**, focused on making ML workloads execute as efficiently as possible, typically through GPU and low-level systems optimization. These aren't rigid tracks, and there is overlap between them. You will bring depth of expertise in at least one of these focus areas and collaborate closely with global team members.

**Your Core Responsibilities**

*The responsibilities below are representative of the role — the exact mix depends on your team, area of expertise and location.*

**ML Research Engineering**

* Develop large-scale distributed training pipelines that manage complex datasets and models.
* Partner with quantitative researchers to automate ML experiments, hyperparameter tuning and model retraining.
* Work with HPC specialists to optimise workflows, improve training speed and reduce compute cost.

**ML Performance Engineering**

* Build and optimise low-latency inference pipelines, ensuring models deliver real-time predictions in production systems.
* Maximise performance in training and inference using GPU hardware and acceleration libraries.

**Across both areas**

* Extend and improve the internals of machine learning frameworks and open-source tools to raise their performance for our workloads.
* Design scalable model infrastructure capable of handling high-volume trading data and delivering real-time, high-accuracy predictions.
* Evaluate and roll out third-party tools that enhance model development, training and inference capabilities.

**Your Skills and Experience**

**Core, regardless of focus area:**

* 3+ years of experience in machine learning, with a focus on training or inference systems.
* **Production software engineering —** Python, testing discipline and genuine ownership of systems once they ship.
* **Machine learning fundamentals —** you understand modern ML workloads beyond high-level APIs and can reason about model behaviour, correctness and performance at the level relevant to your area of expertise.
* **A systems mindset —** you reach for measurement before opinion on performance, scale or reliability issues, and can make sound build-versus-buy decisions.
* **Strong collaboration —** comfortable explaining the reasoning behind your technical decisions, working through differing perspectives with researchers and adapting your approach when the evidence supports it.

**Depth in one or more of the following:**

* **Distributed training and large-scale systems —** parallelism strategy, data pipelines and checkpointing; frameworks such as PyTorch, TensorFlow or JAX.
* **GPU performance and low-level optimisation —** reasoning about memory, compute and latency at the device level, and optimising performance across kernels, compilers and hardware (e.g. CUDA, Triton or equivalent).
* **Production inference systems —** hands-on experience building and hardening real-time, low-latency prediction pipelines in high-performance environments.
* **Numerics and correctness at scale —** low-precision effects, KV caching, batching, and knowing which optimisations stay bit-exact.

*Technologies listed above are examples rather than requirements; equivalent depth developed using other stacks or hardware platforms is equally relevant.*

**Also a plus:**

* Exposure to cloud platforms and orchestration tools.
* A track record of contributing to open-source projects in machine learning, data science or distributed systems.

**Not sure this is the one?** If your strength is mainly in modelling and research direction, our Deep Learning Researcher roles are likely a closer fit. If your strength is in general infrastructure rather than ML-specific systems, take a look at our broader infrastructure engineering roles.

#LI-DNP

**About Us**

*IMC is a research-driven trading firm where quantitative modeling, machine learning, and engineering shape how modern markets are traded. A stabilizing force in markets since 1989, we provide liquidity across trading venues, delivering the best outcome in value and risk management to investors. Using our own technology and capital, we build proprietary systems and algorithms that operate across global markets. Our researchers, traders, and engineers work as a collective, combining rapid experimentation, advanced infrastructure, and real-time feedback to turn insight into execution and execution into advantage.*

We use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to assist our recruiting team review applications (for example, to help match applications against job criteria and organize large volumes of submissions). All hiring decisions are made by people, not AI. We continuously monitor our AI tools to ensure they are used responsibly, with appropriate human oversight. jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, Supply
jobs.description:
Streaming TV is no longer just a brand awareness channel. It’s becoming a core part of the performance marketing mix, alongside search and social. Vibe.co is building the platform that makes TV work like the rest of the acquisition stack: targeted, measurable, and optimized for results.  
  
Vibe.co is an **Audience First Streaming TV Advertising platform** that gives marketers the tools to reach the right audiences, optimize campaigns in real time, and understand what’s actually driving business outcomes. With hyper-targeted segmentation, AI-powered recommendations, real-time optimization, and incrementality measurement, Vibe brings the precision and accountability of digital advertising to the biggest screen in the house.  
  
Today, more than 12,000 brands use Vibe.co to reach 120 million+ households. And in August 2026, Vibe.co became a Walmart company, opening up a new chapter for the business and the industry. With Walmart’s first-party data and purchase signals now part of the Vibe platform, advertisers can connect TV advertising to real-world transactions and measure the impact of CTV with a level of precision previously associated with platforms like Google and Meta.  
  
**This is a unique moment to join Vibe.** With Walmart’s scale, data, and reach behind us, we’re building the next generation of TV advertising and creating a more measurable, performance-driven future for the channel.

**Your team**
-------------

You will join the Supply team, which owns Vibe's inventory: the publishers we partner with, the deals we run, and the catalog of apps, channels and shows our advertisers care about.

Shows are the reason people turn on their TV. Advertisers don't just want impressions: they want to show up next to the right shows, live sports and premium channels. Supply brings that content to Vibe through direct publisher partnerships, curated deals and sponsorships. It makes it easy to find, understand and buy, through real-time bidding, or any technology the publisher uses.

Premium publishers care as much about which ads run on their shows as about who buys them, and great creatives are what earn us access.

The team brings together partnerships, operations, and product. You will work closely with the DSP team, which runs the bidding infrastructure, and the Performance team, which decides how to value each opportunity, as well as with publisher partners directly.

**Your mission**
----------------

As a Senior Software Engineer on Supply, you will build the systems that let Vibe grow, operate, and trust its inventory. You will turn publisher partnerships into live, healthy supply, and give the business and our partners the tools to manage it at scale.

**What you will do**
--------------------

**Publisher integrations**

* Build and improve publisher integrations end-to-end, from onboarding a new partner to supporting new ad formats and sponsorship offers.
* Implement measurement requirements with publishers and the DSP team (e.g. UID2, publisher IDs) so the bidder sees richer inventory.
* Own integration health: detect broken or degraded supply before it costs us spend.

**Deals & catalog**

* Build the services behind deal setup, catalog management, and price configuration, in partnership with DSP on the deal API.
* Automate the routine work of the Supply team (new deals, stale-supply cleanup, troubleshooting) so it scales with the number of partners, and with Vibe.
* Enrich the catalog with content data (shows, genres, live events, channels) so advertisers can find what they are looking for, and even enjoy looking for it.

**Supply tooling & publisher platform**

* Build real-time monitoring, alerting, and analytics on supply volume, quality, and spend.
* Build publisher-facing features: reporting, insights, and self-serve catalog tools.

**What we're looking for**
--------------------------

* 5+ years of experience as a software engineer building and operating backend systems in production.
* Strong programming skills (Go, Python and/or Rust), with real engineering discipline: testing, code review, CI/CD, maintainable design.
* Hands-on with AI coding tools (Claude Code, Codex or similar) in your day-to-day engineering workflow.
* Experience integrating with external partners' systems and APIs, and owning those integrations when they break.
* Comfortable owning services from code to production: cloud infrastructure (AWS or GCP), Kubernetes, and the observability to know your systems are healthy.
* Product sense: you like talking to the people who use what you build, and you turn ambiguous business needs into concrete deliverables.
* Excellent communication in English, with internal teams and with partners' technical contacts.
* Pragmatism over purity: a bias toward shipping value.

**Nice to have**
----------------

* Experience in AdTech or programmatic: OpenRTB, SSPs, PMP / PG deals, VAST.
* Knowledge of the CTV ecosystem (publishers, apps, FAST channels).
* Experience with identity solutions (UID2 or similar).
* Experience building partner-facing or B2B dashboards and reporting.

**Our Values**
--------------

At Vibe, we run on three values: Impact, Ambition, and Urgency. We tie every goal to a real business outcome, think 10x rather than settling for good enough, and move daily rather than waiting for perfect conditions.

You’ll thrive here if you own outcomes without needing direction, default to action, and hold yourself to results, not effort.

This is a high-performance environment with high-performance rewards: you’ll work alongside people who push you, with real ownership over hard problems in a market that’s moving fast.

If that sounds like the best version of your career, we want to meet you.

**What We Offer**

The base pay range for this role in Paris is €90,000 – €125,000. We will support relocation to Paris for great candidates.

The base pay range for this role in New York is $140,000 – $200,000. We will support relocation to New York for great candidates

We are building a fleet of specialized AI services that improve high-value human workflows across the company. Summary
  
  
The Apple Card & Savings team is building the financial products that put users in control of their money. We built Apple Card to reinvent how credit cards work, and we continue to launch groundbreaking features used by millions of people every day. We are looking for an experienced engineer who loves owning critical services end to end, takes pride in operational excellence, and thrives in a highly regulated environment where correctness, reliability, and compliance requirements shape every technical decision.
  
  
Description
  
  
You'll design, build, test, deliver, and operate the distributed services that power Apple Card and Savings — from applications, accounts, and transactions to payments, savings transfers, rewards, and customer notifications. You'll be given the support of a talented team, access to modern technologies, and the autonomy to take full ownership of your work. Our team operates as DevOps: we build what we run. You'll be hands-on in every phase of the lifecycle — shipping changes safely through automated pipelines and controlled rollouts, participating in an on-call rotation, joining incident response and post-incident reviews, and automating away operational toil. You'll build reliable integrations with financial institution and payment network partners and with other Apple services such as Wallet, Apple Cash, and iCloud.
