jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, Data Platform
jobs.description:
At Commure, we're building the AI Operating System for healthcare, the foundation that defines how care is delivered, documented, and financed. Our platform spans the full care journey: Ambient AI and Dictation eliminating documentation burden at the point of care, intelligent Agents automating patient and revenue workflows, and autonomous RCM processing billions in claims, all on a single AI-native platform integrated with 60+ EHRs.

Healthcare carries a $1 trillion administrative burden and we're at the center of transforming it. Today, 500,000+ clinicians across 500+ healthcare organizations nationwide trust Commure to handle $25B+ in annual claims and support over 200 million patient interactions. Our latest $70M raise at a $7B valuation reflects the confidence the market has placed in this mission. We've also been named to the Fortune Future 50 list and the 2026 AI Breakthrough Awards for “Overall NLP Company of the Year.”

Our team works directly alongside clinicians, not through layers of process, which means the gap between what you build and its impact on patient care is immediate. We move fast, deploy daily, and take full ownership from early thinking to production. If you're energized by hard problems, high stakes, and a team that holds itself to a high bar, you'll find your people here.

The future of healthcare is being built right now. Come deliver this transformation.

**About the Role**
------------------

We're hiring a Senior Software Engineer to own Commure's data warehouse platform end-to-end. You'll design, build, and operate every layer of the stack:

* CDC pipelines
* Streaming transport
* Schema governance and data contracts
* Query and serving layer
* Analytics platform

The core stack today: Debezium for CDC, StarRocks as our MPP query and serving engine, and dbt for transformation and modeling. This is a hands-on IC role with broad scope. You'll make architectural calls, write the code that matters most, and establish the patterns and conventions on the data platform.

**What You'll Do**
------------------

* Own the data warehouse platform end-to-end: CDC pipelines, data lake, query layer, transformation layer, and the analytics-facing tooling that sits on top.
* Design and operate CDC pipelines with Debezium (and Kafka, Redpanda, or an equivalent streaming backbone) that move data from operational databases into the warehouse with low latency and high fidelity.
* Architect the data lake on object storage using an open table format (Iceberg, Delta Lake, or Hudi) with Parquet, enabling both batch and streaming workloads and clean separation of storage from compute.
* Run and scale StarRocks (or adjacent MPP/lakehouse engines) as the query and serving layer - schema design, materialized views, ingestion patterns, tuning, and cost/performance trade-offs.
* Build the transformation layer with dbt: modeling standards, tests, documentation, and a semantic layer that gives every team a single source of truth for metrics.
* Stand up orchestration (Airflow, Dagster, or similar) and the CI/CD, observability, and data-quality tooling that make the platform trustworthy day-to-day.
* Partner with Security and Compliance on PHI/PII handling, access controls, lineage, and auditability so the platform meets HIPAA and SOC 2 bar by default.
* Collaborate with product and analytics teams on schema contracts, ingestion patterns, and self-serve tooling so they can build on the platform with confidence.

**What You Have**
-----------------

* 5+ years of software engineering experience, with significant time building or operating data platforms at scale.
* Experience across the modern data stack: CDC (Debezium or equivalent), streaming (Kafka, Redpanda), data lake formats (Iceberg, Delta, Hudi), an MPP or lakehouse query engine (StarRocks, ClickHouse, Trino, Snowflake, Databricks), and dbt.
* Fluent in SQL, schema design, query optimization, and reasoning about cost and latency trade-offs on large datasets.
* Experience running production data infrastructure (orchestration, observability, on-call, data quality, and incident response).

### **Preferred**

* Direct experience with Debezium, StarRocks, and dbt in production.
* Experience building semantic layers (dbt Semantic Layer, Cube) or data catalogs / lineage (DataHub, OpenMetadata, Amundsen).
* Experience with HIPAA-regulated data (PHI handling, de-identification, and access governance).
* Experience powering AI/ML workloads: feature stores, training-set curation, embedding pipelines, or retrieval systems.
* Experience across multiple clouds (AWS, GCP, Azure), infrastructure-as-code (Terraform, Pulumi) and Kubernetes controllers.

Please be aware that all official communication from us will come exclusively from email addresses ending in **@****commure.com**. Any emails from other domains are not affiliated with our organization.

Employees will report to the information security office any confirmed or potential events or other risks to the organization. Employees will be required to attest to these requirements upon hire and on an annual basis.

jobs.description:
Podium Automation is reimagining industrial control panel manufacturing through software-enabled design and automated fabrication. We're building technology to create a new industrial supply chain - reducing lead times for critical electrical equipment from months to days. We've raised over $23M from top-tier investors including Construct Capital, Andreessen Horowitz, Transition Ventures, Sunflower Capital, Banter Capital, and SV Angel.

We are seeking a **Senior Software Engineer** who is excited to invent new technology in the built world. You will own and lead development of our customer portal, Glass, which provides transparency into the state of customer projects and builds a bridge between Podium engineering and stakeholders.

**The Problem You'll Solve**

Podium strives to streamline the process by which a panel is designed and built. But building physical things is hard: requirements change and priorities shift as new information becomes available. Key to reducing the end-to-end ship time is tightening the loop between Podium and our customers.

We’re building, and you will own, a customer-first application that:

* Onboards new customers to Podium
* Houses schematic drawings and collects engineering feedback
* Exposes the state of a build on the floor and enables factory acceptance testing
* Notifies users, both internal and external, when action is needed

Underlying the portal is accurate tracking of material, orders, and customer requirements. Odoo, our ERP solution, is the source truth. Odoo is open source and designed to be extended. You will be our Odoo development expert, supporting the Glass portal and the many other initiatives that rely on our ERP.

**Our Stack:** We use TypeScript, Postgres, SQL Server, HTMX, Docker, Terraform, and AWS. As the owner of this domain, you have the latitude to adopt whatever tools, frameworks, models, or services best fit the problem.

**What You'll Do**

* **Platform Ownership:** Own the technical roadmap and expansion of Glass.
* **Odoo Development:** Build upon Odoo to add data, expose new endpoints, and refine Odoo internals to better align with our business.
* **Cross-Functional Leadership:** Collaborate closely with electrical engineers, sales, and our procurement team. Serve as the technical leader for this domain and a mentor for other engineers.
* **Strategic Growth:** Proactively identify and pursue new opportunities to improve the business through the application of technology. We are a software-enabled hardware company, and when an unexpected opportunity presents itself we take it.

**Who You Are**

There are 4 values that all Podium employees are expected to demonstrate (albeit imperfectly):

* Win for the customer. We sit on the same side of the table as our customers - their wins are our wins. We’re building the vendor we always wished we had.
* Default to transparency. We believe in honesty, transparency, and kindness. It’s about how you get things done and not just what gets done.
* Speed is a feature. We move fast and take ownership. Don’t let perfect be the enemy of good.
* Win and lose as a team. Individuals drive inputs, teams drive outputs. We celebrate success together but aren’t afraid to fail and iterate. We own outcomes together and don’t deflect blame.

  **What We’re Looking For**

  + 5+ years of software engineering experience
  + 1+ years experience developing on Odoo
  + Fluency in TypeScript
  + Commitment to a highly collaborative work environment full of people who like to roll up their sleeves, want a voice, want to build rather than inherit, and share in the results.on-site work environment
  + Available to work in-person in Brooklyn, NY (in person, 5 days/week)

  **Nice To Have**

  + Experience with the Node.js or Deno runtime environment
  + Familiarity with industrial controls or electrical design

  Please note that sponsorship for US employment authorization is not available now or in the future for this position.

Compensation Range: $150K - $190K

jobs.title: Senior Infrastructure Engineer - Operations and Reliability
jobs.description:
**About Nscale**
----------------

Nscale is the GPU cloud engineered for AI. We provide cost-effective, high-performance infrastructure for AI start-ups and large enterprise customers. Nscale enables AI-focused companies to achieve superior results by reducing the complexity of AI development. Our GPU cloud bolsters technical capabilities and directly supports strategic business outcomes, including cost management, rapid innovation, and environmental responsibility.

We thrive on a culture of relentless innovation, ownership, and accountability, where every team member takes pride in their work and drives it with excellence and urgency. As an Nscaler, you'll build trust through openness and transparency, where everyone is inspired to do their best work. If you join our team, you'll be contributing to building the technology that powers the future.

**About The Role**
------------------

We're hiring a **Senior Infrastructure Engineer — Operations & Reliability** to help operate and improve Nscale's OpenStack-based cloud infrastructure. You should have a passion for cloud infrastructure and open-source platforms to join our expanding System Engineering function. This role is pivotal in establishing our follow-the-sun operational model, providing critical coverage for live services during regional operational windows.

You will support live services, resolve incidents across Linux, OpenStack, networking, and virtualization, and work with infrastructure and systems engineering colleagues across time zones. The role combines hands-on operations with opportunities to automate recurring work and improve platform reliability. You will also collaborate with Fleet Management, Network Operations, and other engineering teams when issues cross system boundaries.

**What You'll Be Doing (Responsibilities)**
-------------------------------------------

* **Live Service Operations:** Monitor, triage, and resolve complex Level 2 (L2) incidents across our Unix/Linux and OpenStack cloud environments to safeguard customer SLAs.
* **Platform Support:** Provide hands-on operational support and maintenance across compute, networking, and virtualization layers, specifically focusing on **OpenStack Neutron** (SDN) and **OpenStack Ironic** (bare-metal provisioning).
* **Follow-the-Sun Coverage:** Operate effectively within a rotating shift framework to maintain seamless system reliability during US hours, collaborating and learning from EMEA team peers, paving the way for future APAC systems onboarding.
* **Knowledge Management:** Convert real-time troubleshooting insights into structural capital by creating, refining, and updating standard operating procedures (SOPs) and technical runbooks. Follow up on incidents with documented root-cause analysis and corrective action.
* **Cross-Functional Collaboration:** Work with infrastructure and systems engineering colleagues and partner teams (like Fleet Management, Network Operations, etc.) to diagnose complex issues, make safe platform changes, and escalate when specialist input is needed.
* **Automation and SW Stack Evolution:** Turn recurring issues into lasting improvements through automation, monitoring, configuration changes, and collaboration with the relevant engineering teams.

**About You (Requirements)**
----------------------------

* **Linux/Unix Systems Administration:** Proven commercial experience managing and troubleshooting Linux-based infrastructure at scale.
* **OpenStack Core Competency:** Hands-on experience working with or maintaining OpenStack ecosystems in production or large-scale staging environments.
* **Virtualization Insights:** Practical exposure to hypervisors and virtualization technologies (e.g., KVM, Proxmox).
* **Analytical Triage Mindset:** A methodical, evidence-led, and analytical approach to incident investigation, performance bottlenecks, and root-cause analysis.
* **Communication & Documentation:** Excellent English communication skills, with a proactive approach to technical writing and knowledge sharing.

**Nice to Have**
----------------

* Exposure to cloud-native technologies and container orchestration (Kubernetes).
* Familiarity with infrastructure automation tooling (Ansible, Terraform, Python/Bash scripting).
* Experience with data-centre buildout systems, hardware lifecycle processes, or infrastructure automation.

**What We Can Offer You**
-------------------------

* Highly competitive package (base + equity) with reviews every 12 months.
* **Human-First Flexibility:** We trust Nscalers to deliver, giving you the autonomy to shape your day around life's moments.
* A dynamic progression plan tailored specifically to your ambitions, with explicit mentorship towards Senior Engineering paths.

The range below reflects the base salary for the position. Actual compensation may vary based on job-related factors such as skill set, experience, education, and location. In addition to base salary, this role may be eligible for bonus, equity, and/or commission programs. Nscale may offer a competitive benefits package including medical, dental, vision, flexible paid time off, parental leave, and retirement plan participation.

**Salary Range**

$100,000 - $180,000 USD

**Equal Opportunities Statement**
---------------------------------

We strongly encourage applications from people of colour, the LGBTQ+ community, people with disabilities, neurodivergent people, parents, carers, and people from lower socio-economic backgrounds.

If there's anything we can do to accommodate your specific situation, please let us know.

The responsibilities outlined in this job description are not exhaustive and are intended to provide a general overview of the position. The employee may be required to perform additional duties, tasks, and responsibilities as assigned by management, consistent with the skills and qualifications required for the role.

jobs.title: Forward Deployed Engineer (NYC)
jobs.description:
**About Us**
------------

At Rox, we believe in empowering people to do their best work.

Our platform supercharges sellers with autonomous revenue agents to do the manual work so they can focus on what they do best: selling. Just as coding agents 10x’d engineering, revenue agents 10x customer work.

We are reimagining the revenue stack by building the world’s first revenue operating system, from the application layer to the system of context. With Rox, humans are evolving to orchestrators while agents manage the end-to-end customer lifecycle.

Rox powers Global 2000 leaders in banking, hardware, construction, and sovereign AI, while serving dominant AI winners like Ramp and Cognition.

Underlying all of this success is an unwavering, shared belief in the mission, with an unreasonable commitment of doing whatever it takes to make it a reality.

**The Team**
------------

Nothing is possible without the world-class team, assembled to redefine how businesses operate.

Members on our team have:

* Founded and exited successful companies
* Held the highest positions at Google, AWS, Confluent, and New Relic
* Won IMO and IOI gold medals
* Published field-defining papers

We’re backed by the best, including Sequoia, General Catalyst, Google Ventures, Elad Gil, and Chris Ré.

**Core Principles**
-------------------

### **Taste: Craft beautiful experiences.**

No matter how small, we strive to make sure every detail is right. We care deeply about every interaction, both in terms of whether it helps the seller get the job done, but also how the product makes them feel. We get a visceral feeling when something is off and stop at nothing to make sure we make it right. We never settle, continuously exploring ways to delight sellers.

### **Obsession: Commit unreasonably.**

In all aspects of our craft, we commit. We not only are immediately reactive to customers’ requests but are proactive about driving value even before they ask. We are also obsessive about always learning and honing our craft, improving ourselves and product every single day.

### **Action: Get it done.**

Talking is easy but the difference comes from the execution. We lean heavily towards making thoughtful yet fast decisions and delivering immediately. We play in a field where trust is paramount. We earn the trust and right to empower the best sellers by forging a history of over-delivering on the promise at record speed.

**Your Role**
-------------

As a Forward Deployed Engineer at Rox, you’ll work directly with the world’s top revenue teams to bring AI native workflows to life. This is a high ownership, technical role with a platform engineering focus: onboarding, solution design, deep product adoption, and building durable integrations into complex customer environments.

You’ll lead everything from technical scoping and integration to live demos, trainings, and user activation. Whether you’re mapping complex workflows, writing Python and SQL to support a customer use case, designing systems that fit into large scale IT organizations, or feeding insights into product, you’ll be instrumental in helping users realize value quickly.

You’ll collaborate across sales, product, and platform engineering to shape how Rox is delivered to customers. This is not a traditional CS role. It’s a hands-on, cross-functional role for someone who wants to help define how humans and AI agents work together in practice.

If you’re curious, technical, and obsessed with customer outcomes, we’d love to work with you.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Own post-sale onboarding end-to-end, ensuring every user finds value from their first call onward
* Serve as a trusted technical advisor, proactively engaging users and mapping their workflows to Rox
* Deliver engaging demos, trainings, and live solutioning sessions (remote + in-person)
* Run integration and scoping sessions with GTM and RevOps teams to enable high-impact POCs
* Capture product feedback and use cases to inform roadmap and strategic direction
* Collaborate cross-functionally to build internal documentation, playbooks, and enablement content
* Drive user activation and expansion by delivering compelling value narratives

**Qualifications**
------------------

* 1+ years of experience in B2B SaaS, supporting technical customer relationships (pre- or post-sale)
* Strong execution mindset: you thrive in fast-paced environments and move with urgency
* Background in distributed systems
* Understanding of large scale IT organizations
* Programming experience in Python, plus SQL for working with large datasets
* Fluent in AI native programming and system design
* Familiarity with GTM methodologies (e.g. MEDDIC, SPIN, SPICED) and how users apply them
* Excited to work across onboarding, sales engineering, and customer success in a hybrid role
* Strong communication skills and comfort presenting to both technical and business stakeholders
* Bias toward scaling yourself through process, tooling, and collaboration
* Curious and customer-obsessed: you’re always learning and looking for ways to delight users
* Be located in or willing to relocate to New York

**Benefits**
------------

* Competitive pay with considerable equity upside
* Medical, dental, and vision, including 100% company-paid plans for you and eligible dependents
* Company-paid life & AD&D, plus short- and long-term disability
* 401(k) with automatic enrollment
* Unlimited PTO, plus paid sick leave, company holidays, and bereavement
* Up to 20 weeks of paid parental leave at 100% pay (birth, adoption, or foster)
* Wellness stipend: $375/quarter
* Learning stipend: up to $2,000/year
* Internet & cell phone stipend: $25/month
* Mental health support, virtual care, and care navigation
* Fertility & family-building support, plus backup care membership
* Pre-tax commuter benefits (transit & parking)

new_jobs.description:
### **About the Role**

Join a research and engineering team building privacy and anonymization systems for sensitive data used in AI training. You will help protect personal and confidential information while preserving the structure and utility of data for downstream workflows.

### **What You'll Do**

* Build systems to detect personally identifiable information, quasi-identifiers, credentials, and other sensitive content, then select transformations suited to the data and its intended use.
* Develop and benchmark detection methods that combine rules, statistical models, classifiers, and language models.
* Build production pipelines that anonymize raw data before it reaches processing, training, evaluation, or synthetic data workflows.
* Create evaluation frameworks for privacy risk and retained data utility, including recall-weighted metrics, leakage tests, and adversarial re-identification attempts.
* Design robust systems that handle new data sources, schema drift, unusual formats, and sensitive information in unexpected fields.

* At least 2 years of experience building production data or machine learning systems in Python, with strong Python proficiency.
* A technical education or equivalent technical background, and experience building end-to-end data processing pipelines.
* Hands-on experience detecting, removing, or anonymizing PII while preserving useful characteristics, using information extraction, named-entity recognition, classification, or related methods.
* Experience benchmarking detection methods and evaluating recall, precision, latency, cost, and downstream data utility.
* Understanding of redaction, masking, pseudonymization, anonymization, and synthetic data generation.
* Experience designing systems resilient to schema drift, unusual data formats, and processing edge cases.
* Experience with privacy-enhancing technologies such as differential privacy, k-anonymity, secure aggregation, or format-preserving encryption is valuable.

A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love. That’s what makes us Roche.  
  
Advances in AI, data, and computational sciences are transforming drug discovery and development. Perception, planning, simulation, mapping, validation, and data teams use these tools every day. data.

As a senior metrics-platform engineer, you will design, build and operate a substantial part of  
the platform that makes autonomy evaluation consistent and reproducible. Working directly with  
Perception, Planning and Systems engineers, you will connect model experiments to reliable  
metrics and help turn insights about model behavior, failure modes and generalization into  
improvements in models and data.  
This is a hands-on software engineering role. You will own projects through design,  
implementation, rollout and operation, make practical system-design trade-offs, and mentor  
teammates. As an early member of a newly formed team, you will help establish the engineering  
practices and interfaces that make the platform useful across Autonomy.

  

* Own the design and delivery of a metrics-platform area, such as the metric registry,

  correctness and cost.

Today, ServiceNow is the AI control tower for business reinvention. Our ServiceNow AI platform brings together any AI, any data, and any workflow— helping 85% of the Fortune 500® work smarter, faster, and better. We're building an AI-native culture where technology and talent are unstoppable together. And we're just getting started.

Join us to put AI to work for people.

 **Job Description**

Contribute to the org-wide shift from product-specific search solutions to a composable, agent-native infrastructure foundation that agents and applications build on to locate, search, discover, and recommend resources across heterogeneous enterprise data.

* Build and own the infrastructural substrate beneath the agentic search platform, spanning the index engine, the ingestion and enrichment pipeline, and the entity, identity, and feature intelligence that gives content context. Solve the hard problem of keeping index-time enrichments aligned with what agents expect at query time, so retrieval, ranking, and reasoning all build on a consistent foundation.
* Build and operate hybrid indexing technology at scale across large clusters, spanning keyword-based sparse-vector indices, embedding-based semantic indices, and emerging semantic-ID indexing driven by next-token prediction. Own the full index lifecycle, and expose clean, unified contracts to the search primitives and recipes that agents compose on top of the corpus.
* Design and run high-throughput ingestion and enrichment pipelines that produce a multi-representation, permission-aware corpus at index time. Orchestrate the stages that make content agent-ready, including parsing, chunking, embedding, entity resolution, and access control, and evolve them as new agentic use cases emerge.
* Build and operate multi-modal indexing across the full mix of enterprise data, from free text and structured content such as tables to diagrams, images, and audio and video. ### **About the Role**

Join a small engineering team developing autonomous systems in the defense technology sector. As a senior individual contributor, you will own the precision motion controls stack, from control-loop architecture and state estimation to integration and validation on real hardware.

### **What You'll Do**

* Design and tune precision pointing and tracking control loops, including closed-loop operation from sensor input to actuator commands at hundreds of hertz.
* Develop state estimation and sensor fusion using IMU, encoder, and vision feedback.
* Identify and model gimbal, mount, and actuator dynamics, and compensate for resonance, backlash, friction, saturation, and other nonlinearities.
* Build and maintain controls simulation and hardware-in-the-loop test infrastructure to validate designs and reduce the sim-to-real gap.
* Integrate controls with tracking systems and characterize performance on physical hardware in laboratory and field settings.
* Document controls architecture, tuning approaches, and engineering standards.

### **What We're Looking For**

* At least 4 years of robotics experience, including hands-on design and tuning of closed-loop controllers on motion hardware such as servo drives, brushless motors, encoders, and IMUs.
* Strong grounding in classical and state-space control, including LQR and MPC, with experience applying control methods to physical systems.
* Practical state-estimation experience, such as Kalman, EKF, UKF, or complementary filters, and sensor fusion on hardware.
* Experience with system identification, frequency-domain tuning, resonance characterization, and real-time control-loop latency and jitter.
* Modern C++ for real-time control, plus Python or MATLAB/Simulink for modeling, simulation, and analysis.
* Experience validating simulations against real hardware and working across mechanical, electrical, and software disciplines.
* Background in precision motion, gimbals, target tracking, aerospace, or other related control systems is valuable.

Base salary: $180,000 to $200,000 annually. Visa sponsorship is not available.

On-site in San Francisco, California.

Compensation Range: $180K - $200K

**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

Sponsored Products and Brands (SPB) helps millions of advertisers reach shoppers across Amazon's stores worldwide. Behind every ad we show are machine learning models that predict click-through rate (CTR) and conversion rate (CVR). These predictions decide which ads are relevant, how they rank, and how advertisers get value.  
  
Our team builds and runs the ML infrastructure behind those models, end to end:  
  

* Offline feature engineering: a multi-tenant platform used by several ML teams. It runs thousands of daily feature jobs over petabyte-scale data and produces the features that train models in every marketplace we serve.
* Model training: the standard system that retrains CTR and CVR models every day. How fresh these models are directly affects advertiser results and Amazon's revenue.
* Online feature store and feature retrieval: low-latency, high-throughput services that provide features when a model makes a prediction. These predictions feed the scores used in real-time ad ranking.
* Next-generation research platform: a platform that uses AI agents to help scientists explore, test and launch new model ideas faster.

  
As an SDE II, you'll design, build and run distributed systems that work at very large scale, both in offline batch processing and online serving. You'll work closely with applied scientists and engineers to make models fresher, help scientists try ideas faster, and keep the systems that support ads ranking reliable.  
  
Key job responsibilities  

* Design and develop ML infrastructure for advanced recommendation models, from training through real-time inference, that delivers highly relevant ads to shoppers worldwide
* Improve the scalability, automation and efficiency of large-scale training and real-time inference systems
* Work closely with applied scientists to optimize the performance of ML models and infrastructure, and take models from experimentation into production
* Deliver ML solutions end to end: design, implementation, testing, deployment and operations
* Collaborate with engineers and scientists across the team to build systems that serve ads across all Amazon platforms and surfaces
* Participate in design and code reviews and mentor peers

  
A day in the life  
You might start the day checking the health of the overnight feature and training pipelines. Then you'd work with scientists on how to support a new model architecture, and spend the afternoon building a performance improvement for the online feature store. You'll ship often, see your work affect ads served around the world, and influence how ML infrastructure grows across the organization.  
  
About the team  
The Sponsored Products and Brands team at Amazon Ads is re-imagining the advertising landscape through industry leading generative AI technologies, revolutionizing how millions of customers discover products and engage with brands across Amazon.com and beyond. We are at the forefront of re-inventing advertising experiences, bridging human creativity with artificial intelligence to transform every aspect of the advertising lifecycle from ad creation and optimization to performance analysis and customer insights. We are a passionate group of innovators dedicated to developing responsible and intelligent AI technologies that balance the needs of advertisers, enhance the shopping experience, and strengthen the marketplace. If you're energized by solving complex challenges and pushing the boundaries of what's possible with AI, join us in shaping the future of advertising.
  
  
We're the team behind the full ML lifecycle for Sponsored Products recommendation models, from raw data to features, training and real-time serving. We value ownership, getting things done, and close collaboration with science partners. We invest in mentorship and in tools that make engineers and scientists more productive, including AI-assisted development.

------------------------

* 3+ years of software development engineer or related occupational experience
* 3+ years of designing and developing large-scale, multi-tiered, multi-threaded, embedded or distributed software applications, tools, systems, and services using: C#, C++, Java, or Perl experience

new_jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, Supply
new_jobs.description:
Streaming TV is no longer just a brand awareness channel. It’s becoming a core part of the performance marketing mix, alongside search and social. Vibe.co is building the platform that makes TV work like the rest of the acquisition stack: targeted, measurable, and optimized for results.  
  
Vibe.co is an **Audience First Streaming TV Advertising platform** that gives marketers the tools to reach the right audiences, optimize campaigns in real time, and understand what’s actually driving business outcomes. With hyper-targeted segmentation, AI-powered recommendations, real-time optimization, and incrementality measurement, Vibe brings the precision and accountability of digital advertising to the biggest screen in the house.  
  
Today, more than 12,000 brands use Vibe.co to reach 120 million+ households. And in August 2026, Vibe.co became a Walmart company, opening up a new chapter for the business and the industry. With Walmart’s first-party data and purchase signals now part of the Vibe platform, advertisers can connect TV advertising to real-world transactions and measure the impact of CTV with a level of precision previously associated with platforms like Google and Meta.  
  
**This is a unique moment to join Vibe.** With Walmart’s scale, data, and reach behind us, we’re building the next generation of TV advertising and creating a more measurable, performance-driven future for the channel.

**Your team**
-------------

You will join the Supply team, which owns Vibe's inventory: the publishers we partner with, the deals we run, and the catalog of apps, channels and shows our advertisers care about.

Shows are the reason people turn on their TV. Advertisers don't just want impressions: they want to show up next to the right shows, live sports and premium channels. Supply brings that content to Vibe through direct publisher partnerships, curated deals and sponsorships. It makes it easy to find, understand and buy, through real-time bidding, or any technology the publisher uses.

Premium publishers care as much about which ads run on their shows as about who buys them, and great creatives are what earn us access.

The team brings together partnerships, operations, and product. You will work closely with the DSP team, which runs the bidding infrastructure, and the Performance team, which decides how to value each opportunity, as well as with publisher partners directly.

**Your mission**
----------------

As a Senior Software Engineer on Supply, you will build the systems that let Vibe grow, operate, and trust its inventory. You will turn publisher partnerships into live, healthy supply, and give the business and our partners the tools to manage it at scale.

**What you will do**
--------------------

**Publisher integrations**

* Build and improve publisher integrations end-to-end, from onboarding a new partner to supporting new ad formats and sponsorship offers.
* Implement measurement requirements with publishers and the DSP team (e.g. UID2, publisher IDs) so the bidder sees richer inventory.
* Own integration health: detect broken or degraded supply before it costs us spend.

**Deals & catalog**

* Build the services behind deal setup, catalog management, and price configuration, in partnership with DSP on the deal API.
* Automate the routine work of the Supply team (new deals, stale-supply cleanup, troubleshooting) so it scales with the number of partners, and with Vibe.
* Enrich the catalog with content data (shows, genres, live events, channels) so advertisers can find what they are looking for, and even enjoy looking for it.

**Supply tooling & publisher platform**

* Build real-time monitoring, alerting, and analytics on supply volume, quality, and spend.
* Build publisher-facing features: reporting, insights, and self-serve catalog tools.

**What we're looking for**
--------------------------

* 5+ years of experience as a software engineer building and operating backend systems in production.
* Strong programming skills (Go, Python and/or Rust), with real engineering discipline: testing, code review, CI/CD, maintainable design.
* Hands-on with AI coding tools (Claude Code, Codex or similar) in your day-to-day engineering workflow.
* Experience integrating with external partners' systems and APIs, and owning those integrations when they break.
* Comfortable owning services from code to production: cloud infrastructure (AWS or GCP), Kubernetes, and the observability to know your systems are healthy.
* Product sense: you like talking to the people who use what you build, and you turn ambiguous business needs into concrete deliverables.
* Excellent communication in English, with internal teams and with partners' technical contacts.
* Pragmatism over purity: a bias toward shipping value.

**Nice to have**
----------------

* Experience in AdTech or programmatic: OpenRTB, SSPs, PMP / PG deals, VAST.
* Knowledge of the CTV ecosystem (publishers, apps, FAST channels).
* Experience with identity solutions (UID2 or similar).
* Experience building partner-facing or B2B dashboards and reporting.

**Our Values**
--------------

At Vibe, we run on three values: Impact, Ambition, and Urgency. We tie every goal to a real business outcome, think 10x rather than settling for good enough, and move daily rather than waiting for perfect conditions.

You’ll thrive here if you own outcomes without needing direction, default to action, and hold yourself to results, not effort.

This is a high-performance environment with high-performance rewards: you’ll work alongside people who push you, with real ownership over hard problems in a market that’s moving fast.

If that sounds like the best version of your career, we want to meet you.

**What We Offer**

The base pay range for this role in Paris is €90,000 – €125,000. We will support relocation to Paris for great candidates.

The base pay range for this role in New York is $140,000 – $200,000. We will support relocation to New York for great candidates

new_jobs.description:
Podium Automation is reimagining industrial control panel manufacturing through software-enabled design and automated fabrication. We're building technology to create a new industrial supply chain - reducing lead times for critical electrical equipment from months to days. We've raised over $23M from top-tier investors including Construct Capital, Andreessen Horowitz, Transition Ventures, Sunflower Capital, Banter Capital, and SV Angel.

We are seeking a **Senior Software Engineer** who is excited to invent new technology in the built world. You will own and lead development of our customer portal, Glass, which provides transparency into the state of customer projects and builds a bridge between Podium engineering and stakeholders.

**The Problem You'll Solve**

Podium strives to streamline the process by which a panel is designed and built. But building physical things is hard: requirements change and priorities shift as new information becomes available. Key to reducing the end-to-end ship time is tightening the loop between Podium and our customers.

We’re building, and you will own, a customer-first application that:

* Onboards new customers to Podium
* Houses schematic drawings and collects engineering feedback
* Exposes the state of a build on the floor and enables factory acceptance testing
* Notifies users, both internal and external, when action is needed

Underlying the portal is accurate tracking of material, orders, and customer requirements. Odoo, our ERP solution, is the source truth. Odoo is open source and designed to be extended. You will be our Odoo development expert, supporting the Glass portal and the many other initiatives that rely on our ERP.

**Our Stack:** We use TypeScript, Postgres, SQL Server, HTMX, Docker, Terraform, and AWS. As the owner of this domain, you have the latitude to adopt whatever tools, frameworks, models, or services best fit the problem.

**What You'll Do**

* **Platform Ownership:** Own the technical roadmap and expansion of Glass.
* **Odoo Development:** Build upon Odoo to add data, expose new endpoints, and refine Odoo internals to better align with our business.
* **Cross-Functional Leadership:** Collaborate closely with electrical engineers, sales, and our procurement team. Serve as the technical leader for this domain and a mentor for other engineers.
* **Strategic Growth:** Proactively identify and pursue new opportunities to improve the business through the application of technology. We are a software-enabled hardware company, and when an unexpected opportunity presents itself we take it.

**Who You Are**

There are 4 values that all Podium employees are expected to demonstrate (albeit imperfectly):

* Win for the customer. We sit on the same side of the table as our customers - their wins are our wins. We’re building the vendor we always wished we had.
* Default to transparency. We believe in honesty, transparency, and kindness. It’s about how you get things done and not just what gets done.
* Speed is a feature. We move fast and take ownership. Don’t let perfect be the enemy of good.
* Win and lose as a team. Individuals drive inputs, teams drive outputs. We celebrate success together but aren’t afraid to fail and iterate. We own outcomes together and don’t deflect blame.

  **What We’re Looking For**

  + 5+ years of software engineering experience
  + 1+ years experience developing on Odoo
  + Fluency in TypeScript
  + Commitment to a highly collaborative work environment full of people who like to roll up their sleeves, want a voice, want to build rather than inherit, and share in the results.on-site work environment
  + Available to work in-person in Brooklyn, NY (in person, 5 days/week)

  **Nice To Have**

  + Experience with the Node.js or Deno runtime environment
  + Familiarity with industrial controls or electrical design

  Please note that sponsorship for US employment authorization is not available now or in the future for this position.

Compensation Range: $150K - $190K

new_jobs.title: Forward Deployed Engineer (NYC)
new_jobs.description:
**About Us**
------------

At Rox, we believe in empowering people to do their best work.

Our platform supercharges sellers with autonomous revenue agents to do the manual work so they can focus on what they do best: selling. Just as coding agents 10x’d engineering, revenue agents 10x customer work.

We are reimagining the revenue stack by building the world’s first revenue operating system, from the application layer to the system of context. With Rox, humans are evolving to orchestrators while agents manage the end-to-end customer lifecycle.

Rox powers Global 2000 leaders in banking, hardware, construction, and sovereign AI, while serving dominant AI winners like Ramp and Cognition.

Underlying all of this success is an unwavering, shared belief in the mission, with an unreasonable commitment of doing whatever it takes to make it a reality.

**The Team**
------------

Nothing is possible without the world-class team, assembled to redefine how businesses operate.

Members on our team have:

* Founded and exited successful companies
* Held the highest positions at Google, AWS, Confluent, and New Relic
* Won IMO and IOI gold medals
* Published field-defining papers

We’re backed by the best, including Sequoia, General Catalyst, Google Ventures, Elad Gil, and Chris Ré.

**Core Principles**
-------------------

### **Taste: Craft beautiful experiences.**

No matter how small, we strive to make sure every detail is right. We care deeply about every interaction, both in terms of whether it helps the seller get the job done, but also how the product makes them feel. We get a visceral feeling when something is off and stop at nothing to make sure we make it right. We never settle, continuously exploring ways to delight sellers.

### **Obsession: Commit unreasonably.**

In all aspects of our craft, we commit. We not only are immediately reactive to customers’ requests but are proactive about driving value even before they ask. We are also obsessive about always learning and honing our craft, improving ourselves and product every single day.

### **Action: Get it done.**

Talking is easy but the difference comes from the execution. We lean heavily towards making thoughtful yet fast decisions and delivering immediately. We play in a field where trust is paramount. We earn the trust and right to empower the best sellers by forging a history of over-delivering on the promise at record speed.

**Your Role**
-------------

As a Forward Deployed Engineer at Rox, you’ll work directly with the world’s top revenue teams to bring AI native workflows to life. This is a high ownership, technical role with a platform engineering focus: onboarding, solution design, deep product adoption, and building durable integrations into complex customer environments.

You’ll lead everything from technical scoping and integration to live demos, trainings, and user activation. Whether you’re mapping complex workflows, writing Python and SQL to support a customer use case, designing systems that fit into large scale IT organizations, or feeding insights into product, you’ll be instrumental in helping users realize value quickly.

You’ll collaborate across sales, product, and platform engineering to shape how Rox is delivered to customers. This is not a traditional CS role. It’s a hands-on, cross-functional role for someone who wants to help define how humans and AI agents work together in practice.

If you’re curious, technical, and obsessed with customer outcomes, we’d love to work with you.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Own post-sale onboarding end-to-end, ensuring every user finds value from their first call onward
* Serve as a trusted technical advisor, proactively engaging users and mapping their workflows to Rox
* Deliver engaging demos, trainings, and live solutioning sessions (remote + in-person)
* Run integration and scoping sessions with GTM and RevOps teams to enable high-impact POCs
* Capture product feedback and use cases to inform roadmap and strategic direction
* Collaborate cross-functionally to build internal documentation, playbooks, and enablement content
* Drive user activation and expansion by delivering compelling value narratives

**Qualifications**
------------------

* 1+ years of experience in B2B SaaS, supporting technical customer relationships (pre- or post-sale)
* Strong execution mindset: you thrive in fast-paced environments and move with urgency
* Background in distributed systems
* Understanding of large scale IT organizations
* Programming experience in Python, plus SQL for working with large datasets
* Fluent in AI native programming and system design
* Familiarity with GTM methodologies (e.g. MEDDIC, SPIN, SPICED) and how users apply them
* Excited to work across onboarding, sales engineering, and customer success in a hybrid role
* Strong communication skills and comfort presenting to both technical and business stakeholders
* Bias toward scaling yourself through process, tooling, and collaboration
* Curious and customer-obsessed: you’re always learning and looking for ways to delight users
* Be located in or willing to relocate to New York

**Benefits**
------------

* Competitive pay with considerable equity upside
* Medical, dental, and vision, including 100% company-paid plans for you and eligible dependents
* Company-paid life & AD&D, plus short- and long-term disability
* 401(k) with automatic enrollment
* Unlimited PTO, plus paid sick leave, company holidays, and bereavement
* Up to 20 weeks of paid parental leave at 100% pay (birth, adoption, or foster)
* Wellness stipend: $375/quarter
* Learning stipend: up to $2,000/year
* Internet & cell phone stipend: $25/month
* Mental health support, virtual care, and care navigation
* Fertility & family-building support, plus backup care membership
* Pre-tax commuter benefits (transit & parking)
* SF HQ: daily catered breakfast & lunch, meal allowances, and rideshare support when commuting to the office

**Apply**

* Experience implementing multi-agent systems using frameworks (e.g., LangGraph, CrewAI, ADK) and patterns (e.g., ReAct, self-reflection, hierarchical delegation).

**About the job**
-----------------

As a GenAI Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE) at Google Cloud, you will be an embedded builder who bridges the gap between frontier AI products and production-grade reality within customers. Unlike traditional advisory roles, you will function as an innovator-builder, moving beyond high-level architecture to code, debug, and jointly ship bespoke agentic solutions directly within the customer’s environment.

This role is designed for high-agency engineers with a founder’s mindset. You will address blockers to production including solving the integration complexities, data readiness issues, and state-management issues that prevent AI from reaching enterprise-grade maturity. By embedding with accounts, you will serve a dual purpose: providing white glove deployment of AI systems and acting as a critical feedback loop, transforming real-world field insights into Google Cloud’s future product roadmap.

It's an exciting time to join Google Cloud’s Go-To-Market team, leading the AI revolution for businesses worldwide. You’ll excel by leveraging Google's brand credibility—a legacy built on inventing foundational technologies and proven at scale. We’ll provide you with the world's most advanced AI portfolio, including frontier Gemini models, and the complete Vertex AI platform, helping you to solve business problems. We’re a collaborative culture providing direct access to DeepMind's engineering and research minds, empowering you to solve customer challenges. Join us to be the catalyst for our mission, drive customer success, and define the new cloud era—the market is yours.

Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.
  
  
US: $174000 - $252000 (USD) + 15% bonus target + equity + benefits  
  
Learn more about benefits at Google.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Serve as a developer for complex AI applications, transitioning from rapid prototypes to production-grade agentic workflows (e.g., multi-agent systems, model context protocol (MCP) servers) that drive measurable return on investment.
* Architect and code the connective tissue between Google’s AI products and customer's live infrastructure, including APIs, legacy data silos, and security perimeters as part of an expert team.
* Build high-performance evaluation pipelines and observability frameworks to ensure agentic systems meet requirements for accuracy, safety, and latency.
* Identify repeatable field patterns and friction points in Google’s AI stack, converting them into reusable modules or formal product feature requests for the Engineering teams.
* Co-build with customer engineering teams to instill Google-grade development best practices, ensuring long-term project success and high end-user adoption.
